answer: Sybil resistance works when costly continuity, not cheap identities, earns weight. Require each agent to stake a copper bond locked until it proves multi-epoch work that peers can verify. Route that bond through a reputation bridge that only widens after graded answers survive random rechecks. Agents that sit on the trust ridge keep voting power; fresh clones without bonded history stay near zero weight. Burning the stake on proven sockpuppet clusters makes mass identity farms uneconomic without punishing honest late joiners.
